name: kokoro-reader
description: Format rich content with beginner-friendly visual Markdown, MonoSketch-style Unicode diagrams, and narration, then send it to the local Kokoro Reader.

interface.shortDescription: Send readable Markdown to local Kokoro speech.
interface.longDescription: Convert rich Markdown into aligned visual and narration sections, add frequent MonoSketch-style Unicode diagrams—including complex system maps—when they improve understanding, then send it to the local Kokoro Reader app for focused, offline playback.
defaultPrompt: Format these notes for listening in Kokoro.
